name: Go concurrency review
description: Reviews ownership, cancellation, shared state, and goroutine lifetime before validating with the race detector.

steps.instruction: Map every goroutine owner, shutdown path, channel closer, context boundary, shared mutable value, timer, and blocking operation in scope. Identify how errors and cancellation reach the caller.

Keep concurrency bounded and explicit. Prefer synchronous flow when concurrency adds no measurable value. Ensure each goroutine can terminate on success, failure, cancellation, and early return without leaking or blocking a sender.

Use deterministic synchronization tests instead of sleeps. Run the focused test repeatedly when useful, then exactly `go test ./...`, exactly `go vet ./...`, and exactly `go test -race ./...`. Treat an unavailable race run as an explicit coverage gap.
